findings.quote: Generative artificial intelligence holds much promise, but it may also lead us to cross a Rubicon and into more danger than we can control.
findings.rationale: Quotes a warning about AI benefits and potentially uncontrollable risks.

findings.quote: AI will fundamentally disrupt our assumptions on military doctrine and strategic deterrence.
findings.rationale: Identifies AI's effects on military strategy and rapid weapons deployment.

findings.quote: There will be many occasions when humans may not even be in the firing loop
findings.rationale: Continues the preceding AI weapons discussion, warning of reduced decision time, lost human control and escalation.

findings.quote: the advent of artificial intelligence in conflict situations has actually increased the risks exponentially.
findings.rationale: Calls for inclusive UN dialogue and oversight of AI systems to reduce conflict and nuclear escalation risks.

findings.quote: this offers some useful lessons for other areas, including AI.
findings.rationale: Uses UN cyber negotiations as a model for international AI norms and cooperation.

findings.quote: We need to bring the same constructive spirit to other areas of the global commons — AI, cybersecurity, digital technology and even outer space.
findings.rationale: Calls for cooperative multilateral governance of AI as a global commons issue.
